name: Folk rock

hallmarks: straight eighths on the ride or the hat under jangling guitars
a plain backbeat, the kick on 1, the 'and' of 2 and 3
few fills, at the ends of choruses

summary: Folk songs and their singers with a rock band behind them, from the Byrds' Mr. Tambourine Man (1965) on; in Los Angeles often played by the session players.
